paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 4, halakhah 12, he asked Rabbi Yitzchak about a mezuzah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: טברי is unvocalized; Tavri is a transliteration, without identifying a place or another person.

The Guggenheimer digital paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:12 explicitly has Bar Tabbari asking Rabbi Yitzchak about a mezuzah. This supports the direction of the question and the local full title. The supplied leading ב is retained in Hebrew, and Tavri remains the heading-based transliteration without a place or identity resolution.
